name: What is the typical process for a home renovation project with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a home renovation project with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with an initial consultation to discuss your project vision, budget, and timeline. Next, the contractor will provide a detailed proposal and contract. Once agreed upon, design and planning phases occur, including securing necessary permits. Construction then commences, with the general contractor overseeing all trades, managing schedules, and conducting regular site visits. The project concludes with final inspections and a walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. City Dweller, LLC keeps you informed at every stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The typical process includes consultation, proposal, design, permitting, construction oversight, and final walkthrough. The contractor manages all stages, keeping the client informed.
